description: Who has better TikTok Shop marketing? Bum Energy or Ghost? 👻 Let me know what you think 🤔
transcript: Who's better at marketing on TikTok Shop, Bum Energy or ghost? And both of these brands are absolutely crushing it. Bum Energy has sold over 36,000 products on TikTok Shop. They're an official shop badge partner, they have 18 repeat purchasers, and they are opted into basically every TikTok Shop program you can think of. Coupons, special offers, smart promotion, seller campaigns, follower discounts. They know if someone follows the account they're more likely to buy from. That simple click action. But here's what makes bum Energy dangerous. They have a creator army. Thousands of influencers are pushing their product with product reviews, flavor taste test, gym content, workout videos, reaction videos, flavor packs, comparisons, product breakdowns, and energy drink education. And the comments are doing half the selling. People are debating the flavors, people are asking which one tastes better. People are saying they need to try it. This is exactly how TikTok Shop drives impulse purchases. Now look at Ghost. Ghost has been around for years, but on TikTok Shop they are still moving with serious volume. Over 61,000 drinks sold, 86,000 total products sold, but only 14 repeat shop buyers. And that tells you the strategy right there. They're using TikTok Shop to drive massive first time customer acquisition because ghost already has retail distribution everywhere. So every TikTok shop sell does not just create revenue, it creates awareness around the product. It creates product trial. It it's lift. It creates a Halo effect across the entire Brand and their flavor strategy is genius. Welches, warheads, sour flavors, blue raspberry, crazy limited flavor partnerships that make people want to try the product immediately. And creators turn those into flavor content. Taste tests, store finds, workout videos, podcast clips, product comparisons, flavor rankings, in store reactions. So Bum Energy is building one of the strongest native TikTok Shop Creator engines, but ghost is using TikTok Shop as a full funnel awareness machine that spills into retail. Both are winning. Both understand creator LED distribution. Both know TikTok Shop is not just a sales channel. It is a content engine, creator engine, and retail demand engine all at once. But who do you think is doing it better, bum energy or ghost?
